about: Each fact this skill states in its own words, with the page that states it and a phrase that page must still carry. No checker ships with this skill: re-check each by hand against its page; when one fails, re-read the page and correct the skill and this line together.

watch.what: strict is on by default in TypeScript 6.0
Node strips types by default and refuses non-erasable syntax
errors are identified by code, not message
typescript-eslint supports TypeScript below 6.1.0, which holds the starting package.json on TypeScript 6.0
strict-type-checked is not stable under semver, so typescript-eslint is pinned exactly
watch.pattern: may change outside of major version updates
watch.value: may change outside of major version updates
